Plan a drone mapping flight over a 780 m × 972 m site at 40 m altitude. The camera's horizontal field of view across the flight line is 84°. Use 80% side overlap.
Image footprint width = 2 × altitude × tan(FOV/2). Line spacing = footprint × (1 − side overlap). Flight lines run along the 972 m side: number of lines = ceil(width ÷ spacing) + 1. Flight distance = lines × 972 m + (lines − 1) × spacing for the turns. The drone flies at 8 m/s and each battery gives 25 minutes of survey flight. Give the footprint width, line spacing, number of lines, flight minutes and batteries needed (rounded up).
Answer keys: "footprint_width_m" (number), "line_spacing_m" (number), "flight_lines" (integer), "flight_minutes" (number), "batteries" (integer).

title: Rebar-tying robot vs crew
prompt:

The first and last bar each sit 2 in in from the edges; bars per direction = floor((dimension across them − 2 × cover) ÷ spacing) + 1 (work in inches). Give bars each way, ties, robot hours and crew hours.
Answer keys: "bars_long_direction" (integer), "bars_short_direction" (integer), "ties" (integer), "robot_hours" (number), "crew_hours" (number).
